messages:
Sam: Quick sync — compiling the SI Enablement toolkit inventory for the new marketplace partners. Who can confirm final list of lab kits, cloud SKUs, and certification modules? Need before Friday.

Priya: I can share the lab kit inventory. Uploaded a spreadsheet earlier this week under Partnerships Drive. @Diego did you update the cloud SKU mapping?

Diego: Yes updated mapping. Short excerpt:
```
lab_kits: ['edge-kit-v2', 'inference-rack-16', 'nvlink-sandbox']
cloud_skus: ['rwd-dedicated-gpu-1', 'rwd-marketplace-starter', 'hw-partner-gpux']
cert_modules: ['basics', 'deployment', 'security-compliance']
```

Marta: Heads-up: hardware partner asked for a separate SKU for quantized models. We should include 'hw-quant-accelerator' — flagged in the tracker.

Sam: Ok added. Also need training modules owners for each cert module — @Priya for basics, @Marta for security, who picks up deployment?

Diego: I can own deployment content (slides + lab guide). Will drop a PR by tomorrow.

partners-bot: Reminder: joint announcement embargo window opens 2025-06-01. Flag anything customer-facing.

Priya: Quick checklist for final pass:
- verify SKUs in marketplace catalog
- confirm lab kit shipping lead times
- record training owner + estimated effort
- prepare one-pager for partner comms

Sam: Great. Can everyone drop final statuses into the spreadsheet by EOD Thursday? I’ll run a short handoff call Friday 10am PT.

Marta: ✅ will update shipping lead times by EOD.

Diego: ✅ PR in the repo by 5pm PT.

Priya: ✅ one-pager draft uploaded.

Sam: Thanks — see you on Friday. :rocket:
